feature_contract: per-promoter mono(4)+dinuc(16)+GC(1)+length(1) computed on BOTH sym400 and up2000 => 44 features; gene feature = mean over the gene's promoters; z-score fit on train-inner only (final fit on full original train)
sequences: sym400 (promoter_sym400_uint8.memmap) and up2000 (promoter_up2000_uint8.memmap), same rows as scratch encoder
training_scope: human original-train genes only (46618 genes); no v6.3 weights, no labels, no donor-ortholog transfer
selection_rule: max inner-val gene E Spearman on deterministic 90/10 gene holdout (seed 20261011), identical split to scratch encoder
final_fit: ridge(selected alpha) on FULL original 46618 train genes; z-score on full train; evaluate once on frozen val/test
comparison_purpose: isolate whether from-scratch CNN learns more than raw composition; NOT a leakage-free claim for v6.3/gene.rc5
